- Documentation: [https://github.com/one-acre-fund/mega-linter-plugin-logstash](https://github.com/one-acre-fund/mega-linter-plugin-logstash)

- Maintainer: [Yann Jouanique](https://github.com/Yann-J)

> ⚠️ **Required items are missing in this plugin** (native mode, SARIF output): see [MegaLinter checks](#megalinter-checks).

&#x27;mustache&#x27; is a Logstash configuration file parser that will check for valid syntax

## Configuration in MegaLinter

- Enable mustache by adding `LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE` in [ENABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)
- Disable mustache by adding `LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE` in [DISABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)

| Variable                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default value      |
|-----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_ARGUMENTS                   | User custom arguments to add in linter CLI call<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                                            |                    |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_COMMAND_REMOVE_ARGUMENTS    | User custom arguments to remove from command line before calling the linter<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                |                    |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_FILTER_REGEX_INCLUDE        | Custom regex including filter<br/>Ex: `(src\|lib)`                                                                                                                                                                  | Exclude no file    |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_FILTER_REGEX_EXCLUDE        | Custom regex excluding filter<br/>Ex: `(test\|examples)`                                                                                                                                                            | Exclude no file    |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_CLI_LINT_MODE               | Override default CLI lint mode<br/>- `file`: Calls the linter for each file                                                                                                                                         | `list_of_files`    |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_FILE_EXTENSIONS             | Allowed file extensions. `"*"` matches any extension, `""` matches empty extension. Empty list excludes all files<br/>Ex: `[".py", ""]`                                                                             | `[".conf"]`        |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_FILE_NAMES_REGEX            | File name regex filters. Regular expression list for filtering files by their base names using regex full match. Empty list includes all files<br/>Ex: `["Dockerfile(-.+)?", "Jenkinsfile"]`                        | Include every file |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_PRE_COMMANDS                | List of bash commands to run before the linter                                                                                                                                                                      | None               |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_POST_COMMANDS               | List of bash commands to run after the linter                                                                                                                                                                       | None               |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_UNSECURED_ENV_VARIABLES     | List of env variables explicitly not filtered before calling LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE and its pre/post commands                                                                                                            | None               |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_DISABLE_ERRORS              | Run linter but consider errors as warnings                                                                                                                                                                          | `false`            |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_DISABLE_ERRORS_IF_LESS_THAN | Maximum number of errors allowed                                                                                                                                                                                    | `0`                |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS             | Maximum duration in seconds of the linter run, after which the linter process and its child processes are killed and reported as an error (exit code 124). Overrides LINTER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. 0 disables the timeout | `300`              |
| LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE_CLI_EXECUTABLE              | Override CLI executable                                                                                                                                                                                             | `['mustache']`     |
| LOGSTASH_DIRECTORY                            | Directory containing LOGSTASH files (use `any` to always activate the linter)                                                                                                                                       | `logstash`         |

## Use this plugin

Add the descriptor URL of the plugin to `PLUGINS` in `.mega-linter.yml`. MegaLinter installs the plugin when it starts, whatever the flavor:

```yaml
PLUGINS:
  - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/one-acre-fund/mega-linter-plugin-logstash/main/mega-linter-plugin-logstash/logstash.megalinter-descriptor.yml
```

## Behind the scenes

### How are identified applicable files

- Activated only if sub-directory `logstash` is found. (directory name can be overridden with `LOGSTASH_DIRECTORY`)
- File extensions: `.conf`

<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
<!-- /* cSpell:disable */ -->
### How the linting is performed

- mustache is called one time by identified file (`file` CLI lint mode)

### Example calls

```shell
mustache check 01-web.conf
```


### Installation in Docker

MegaLinter runs these commands when it loads the plugin (only `RUN` instructions):

```dockerfile
RUN ML_THIRD_PARTY_DIR="/third-party/mustache" \\
    && MUSTACHE_VERSION=0.5.3 \\
    && mkdir -p ${ML_THIRD_PARTY_DIR} \\
    && wget -P ${ML_THIRD_PARTY_DIR} -q "https://github.com/breml/logstash-config/releases/download/v${MUSTACHE_VERSION}/mustache_${MUSTACHE_VERSION}_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz" \\
    && tar xf ${ML_THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/mustache_${MUSTACHE_VERSION}_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz --directory ${ML_THIRD_PARTY_DIR} \\
    && mv ${ML_THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/mustache /usr/local/bin \\
    && rm -rf ${ML_THIRD_PARTY_DIR}

```

### Installation without Docker (native mode)

> **Native mode does not run plugins yet**: this section shows what the plugin declares for native mode.

Not available: see the MegaLinter checks of the plugin.

## MegaLinter checks

These results last changed on 2026-11-28, and MegaLinter checks the plugins every day. The checks only look at the descriptor of the plugin: they do not review the plugin, nor the tool it runs.

| Check        | Result                                  |
|:-------------|:----------------------------------------|
| Descriptor   | ⚠️ Incomplete                           |
| Native mode  | ❌ Not supported                        |
| SARIF output | ❌                                      |
| Native lock  | ⚠️ No lock shipped by the plugin author |

### Required

Missing required items:

- **`native_install` declared and valid for the 5 native platforms** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`): Native mode (MegaLinter without Docker) can not install the linter. Declare `native_install`, listing each of linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 in `platforms` or in `unsupported` (with a reason)
- **SARIF output** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`): The findings are missing from SARIF reports (GitHub code scanning, SARIF viewers, coding agents). Set `can_output_sarif: true` with `cli_sarif_args` when the tool outputs SARIF, otherwise `sarif_text_regex` (one finding per line of text) or `sarif_unified_diff: true` (formatters printing a diff)

### Recommended

Missing recommended items:

- **Native lock shipped next to the descriptor (`<name>.megalinter-native-lock.json`), for verified native installs**
- **Rules documentation URL (`linter_rules_url`)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
- **Configuration documentation URL (`linter_rules_configuration_url`)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
- **Inline disable documentation URL (`linter_rules_inline_disable_url`)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
- **Ignore file documentation URL (`linter_rules_ignore_config_url`)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
- **Speed (`linter_speed`, 1 to 5)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
- **Icon (`linter_icon_png_url`)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
- **IDE extensions (`ide`)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
- **Supported lint modes (`supported_cli_lint_modes`)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
- **Default configuration file (`config_file_name`)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
- **Test fixtures (`test_folder`)** (`LOGSTASH_MUSTACHE`)
